pfaff-pokegama-chautauqua.st: A 1898 newspaper item describes the Chetek Chautauqua and camp meeting grounds as "a short distance from town", with "one of the best views of the lakes", and says visitors camped in tents. It does not say the grounds were on an island, so it may be an earlier mainland site rather than Pokegama Island. It isn't counted as a second source for this pin.
src: Newspaper item, 1898, Chetek Chautauqua grounds (newspapers.com, PC thread sweep)
